sidebar.title: Pilot onboarding
sidebar.subtitle: Six steps from an idea to a live ontology.

step1.title: Scope the pilot
step1.subtitle: A pilot is a narrow slice that proves the ontology in one domain before you scale out. Keep it focused — one process, one team, one or two weeks of data.
step1.scopePlaceholder: Which question will the pilot answer? Who needs the answer?
step1.scopeHint: One or two sentences. You can edit this later from the design workbench.

step2.title: Connect a source
step2.subtitle: Pick the data source the pilot reads from. The federation layer stays decoupled — you can register more sources later.
step2.connectionHint: Credentials are never stored in the browser — the final step registers them through the encrypted federation admin API.

step3.title: Seed the glossary
step3.subtitle: Glossary terms are the business vocabulary. One per line, with the canonical term first and optional aliases separated by commas.
step3.draftPlaceholder:
Order — purchase, transaction
Customer — buyer
VIP tier — top-tier customer, loyalty
step3.draftHint: Drafted terms become CreateGlossaryTerm ops on Finish. You can refine them in the admin UI afterwards.

step4.title: Capture rules
step4.subtitle: Rules express invariants the LLM-generated queries must respect (SHACL). One per line in plain English — the design agent turns them into SHACL shapes later.
step4.draftPlaceholder:
Every Order has exactly one Customer
Order.status must be one of: placed, paid, fulfilled, cancelled
Amount is always non-negative
step4.draftHint: Ambiguous lines become clarification questions, not silent failures — the agent will ask.

step5.title: Map to topology
step5.subtitle: Tell us roughly how the source tables correspond to node types — one table per node is the common case; use the notes to describe exceptions.
step5.notesPlaceholder:
orders → Order
customers → Customer
order_items → bridge for Order←contains→Product
step5.notesHint: The design agent proposes ObjectMapping + LinkMapping entries from this plus the source schema.

step6.title: Validate and launch
step6.subtitle: You've captured the intent. Finish to hand over to the design agent — it materialises the ontology, runs introspection, and opens the workbench focused on your pilot.
